description: Get public issuer financials for an exact Aptos, Sui, Noble, Stellar or XRP Ledger token. Preserve identifier case. Each metric states its unit, fund/global/deployment scope, source and freshness; null means unavailable, not zero. Fund AUM and NAV do not establish token supply, redemption capacity or reserves. Requery by refreshBy; this tool does not return a risk score or private account data.
